task_summary: Refactor interleave and interleave_legacy to delegate their shared algorithm to one private helper, preserving public signatures, return types, error behavior, input immutability, imports, and public names. Keep the implementation and tests within the supplied task workspace.
constraints: Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Alternate left then right items, then append any remainder from the longer input in order; empty inputs are valid.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least two passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.

success_criteria.description: solution.py defines the public interleave and interleave_legacy functions and a private helper.
test_solution.py contains at least two unittest test methods.

assumptions: Paths are interpreted relative to the supplied task workspace; solution.py and test_solution.py may not exist yet and may be created.
The exact existing signatures, return annotations, error behavior, imports, and public names are not specified in the request and must be inferred from the supplied workspace files when present.
The requested unittest discovery command is interpreted as Python's standard-library unittest discovery from the workspace root; the suite is assumed discoverable that way.

A successful discovery exit status alone does not prove test methods were collected; the separate structural check requires at least two unittest test methods, and the workspace-file review assesses their public API coverage.
